note: Triennial election of the county council, 1952: nominations 20 May 1952; every seat returned unopposed. The list prints no party labels (so none are given) and has no entry for Crossmore. Returned unopposed. Norman Stronge: no party label printed in 1952. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Mid Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 10 February 1949, listed as Unionist; Mid Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 22 October 1953, listed as Unionist).
